angle: Kaito Fujiwara’s close-range finish (assist: Davide Sartori) extends Northbridge Athletic’s lead early in the second half and gives him his second goal of the match, coming from a short 3-pass, 14.6s build-up.

explanation.why_it_matters: After a chaos peak (86) Northbridge regained control (control_share 0.69) and used a short 3-pass, 14.6s build-up; Sartori’s higher-difficulty assist (56, assist_dva -0.006) found Fujiwara for a 4.5m finish (xG 0.375). The goal extends the lead to 2-0, converting earlier scramble into controlled advantage.

en.headline: Fujiwara doubles the lead
en.body: Kaito Fujiwara finishes from close range after Davide Sartori's pass. Northbridge look more comfortable early in the second half.

it.headline: Fujiwara raddoppia
it.body: Kaito Fujiwara finalizza da breve distanza dopo il passaggio di Davide Sartori. Il Northbridge sembra più a suo agio all'inizio della ripresa.

es.headline: Fujiwara dobla la ventaja
es.body: Kaito Fujiwara remata desde muy cerca tras el pase de Davide Sartori. Northbridge se muestra más cómodo al inicio de la segunda mitad.

ja.headline: 藤原がリードを広げる
ja.body: サルトリのパスを受けた藤原海斗が至近距離から決める。後半序盤、Northbridgeはより落ち着いている印象だ。

en.headline: Key metrics behind the finish
en.body: xG 0.375; build-up xT 0.008; assist DVA -0.006; assist difficulty 56. Short three-pass, 14.6s sequence created the high-probability close-range chance.

it.headline: Metriche chiave dietro la conclusione
it.body: xG 0.375; build-up xT 0.008; assist DVA -0.006; assist difficulty 56. Sequenza breve di tre passaggi, durata 14,6s, che ha creato l'occasione ravvicinata ad alta probabilità.

es.headline: Métricas clave detrás del gol
es.body: xG 0.375; build-up xT 0.008; assist DVA -0.006; assist difficulty 56. Secuencia corta de tres pases, 14.6s, que creó la ocasión de alta probabilidad desde cerca.

ja.headline: フィニッシュの主要指標
ja.body: xG 0.375; build-up xT 0.008; assist DVA -0.006; assist difficulty 56。短い三本のパス、14.6秒の連続で高確率の至近距離チャンスを生み出した。

en.headline: Goal: Fujiwara scores
en.body: Inside the box, centrally, Kaito Fujiwara receives Davide Sartori's pass and shoots with his foot. The shot goes in and the goal extends Northbridge Athletic's lead to 2-0.

it.headline: Gol: segna Fujiwara
it.body: Dentro l'area, centralmente, Kaito Fujiwara riceve il passaggio di Davide Sartori e tira di piede. Il tiro entra e il gol porta il vantaggio del Northbridge Athletic sul 2-0.

es.headline: Gol: marca Fujiwara
es.body: Dentro del área, en zona central, Kaito Fujiwara recibe el pase de Davide Sartori y dispara con el pie. El tiro entra y el gol sitúa la ventaja de Northbridge Athletic en 2-0.

ja.headline: ゴール：藤原が得点
ja.body: ペナルティボックス内の中央で、藤原海斗がDavide Sartoriのパスを受け、足でシュートします。シュートはゴールに吸い込まれ、Northbridge Athleticのリードは2-0になります。

en.headline: Fujiwara's composed close-range finish
en.body: Kaito Fujiwara times his run, meets Sartori's assist and slots a close-range finish. He now has 2 goals from 6 shots and 0.97 xG in the match.

it.headline: La freddezza di Fujiwara in area
it.body: Kaito Fujiwara temporeggia la sua corsa, incrocia l'assist di Sartori e insacca da breve distanza. Ora ha 2 gol su 6 tiri e 0.97 xG nella partita.

es.headline: Definición tranquila de Fujiwara desde cerca
es.body: Kaito Fujiwara ajusta la carrera, llega al pase de Sartori y define a puerta desde corta distancia. Ahora suma 2 goles de 6 disparos y 0.97 xG en el partido.

ja.headline: 藤原の冷静な至近距離フィニッシュ
ja.body: 藤原海斗はタイミングよく走りを合わせ、Sartoriのアシストに合わせて至近距離で流し込んだ。これで6本中2ゴール、試合でのxGは0.97になった。
